name: EL-Casino Launchpad
version: 3 (Uniswap v4 + the EL launch hook, live 2026-10-28)
summary: Token launchpad: every launch is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 (1,000,000,000, 18 decimals, no mint, no transfer tax, no owner) that trades on its own Uniswap v4 pool from the first block, against native ETH or an owner-listed quote asset (tokenized stocks / stables). 80% of the supply is the pool's single-sided liquidity, owned by the launchpad forever (the hook refuses every removal); 20% goes to the token's game reserve (10% casino rooms in every EL-Casino game, 7% perps vault, 3% predict house). The launch hook takes a fixed 3% of every swap in the quote asset. There is no bonding curve: 'unlocked' (graduated) = the launch position holds the quote's gradAmount (4.2 ETH for ETH), which opens the token's perps and predict markets.

previousVersion.note: Launchpad V6 (Uniswap v3, 2026-10-24 → 2026-10-28): its few tokens still trade on their v3 pools; no new launches there.

detectingLaunches.event: Launched(address indexed token, address indexed creator, address indexed quote, address poolView, bool holders)

views.tokens(uint256 i) returns (address): the i-th launch token, oldest first
views.launches(address token) returns (address: a launch: its creator, quote asset (address(0) = native ETH), v3-shaped pool view, anti-snipe settings and locked position
views.keyOf(address token) returns (PoolKey): the token's Uniswap v4 PoolKey (fee 0, tickSpacing 200, hooks = the launch hook)
views.creatorOf(address token) returns (addres: the creator (fee wallet); can be handed over by the creator
views.quoteInPool(address token) returns (uint: the quote held in the launch position (graduation progress)

pool.hookFee: 3% of every swap, in the quote asset, taken by the launch hook
pool.pair: TOKEN / quote (native ETH or an owner-listed asset)
pool.liquidity: one single-sided position from the opening price outward, owned by the launchpad; the hook refuses every removal
pool.swapEvent: Uniswap v4 PoolManager Swap(bytes32 indexed id, address indexed sender, int128 amount0, int128 amount1, uint160 sqrtPriceX96, uint128 liquidity, int24 tick, uint24 fee), topic0 0x40e9cecb9f5f1f1c5b9c97dec2917b7ee92e57ba5563708daca94dd84ad7112f, filtered by the pool id
pool.priceView: each launch's poolView answers slot0() / observe() like a v3 pool (the hook keeps a 4000-slot observation ring)

graduation.name: unlock
graduation.rule: the launch position holds >= the quote's gradAmount (4.2 ETH for ETH) and the token is at least a day old — perps and predict markets open; trading never moves

views: socials() returns (string website, string x, string telegram, string discord, string farcaster)
events: SocialsUpdated(string website, string x, string telegram, string discord, string farcaster)

fees.launchFee: 0.003 ETH per ETH launch (the keeper budget that opens the token's rooms and markets); other quotes: an owner-set amount sent to the burner
fees.tradingFee: 3% of every swap, in the quote asset. process(token) splits it (Processed, topic0 0xe733e999852d339207730c3c3f1c7d75e9625aad45ec801a0b921867d1381c83): a third to the burner (buys and burns $ELCAS), a third buys the token back for its game stakers, a third to the creator — or, if chosen at launch, bought as an index of tokenized stocks and paid to the token's holders
fees.taxes: none — the token has no transfer tax

launchProtection.what: Chosen by the creator at launch: an anti-snipe window of 0, 5 min, 10 min or 1 h. During it every buy must go through the launchpad (direct pool swaps are refused by the hook) and pays an extra tax decaying linearly from startTaxBps (<= 30%) to 0; optional per-buy and per-wallet caps and an optional merkle whitelist apply. Sells are never limited. After the window anyone trades on any Uniswap v4 router.

securityScannerNotes.external_call: The token has no transfer hook; the window is enforced by the pool's hook and the launchpad router.
securityScannerNotes.anti_whale: Only inside the creator's window (at most 1 day), set once at launch; not modifiable.

openData.indexHint: Every launch: Launched logs of the launchpad from deployBlock; trades: PoolManager Swap logs filtered by each launch's pool id.
